_comment: model=linear: age = round(intercept + sum(category_weights * severity score) + rating_offsets[rated] + genre_offsets[genre...] + numeric terms), clamped to [min_age, max_age], then raised to rating_floor[rated] if lower. Severity score per category is the vote-weighted mean (None=0 .. Severe=3) when IMDb vote counts are cached, else the median level. Coefficients were fitted to hand-labelled ages (see README); rating_floor covers ratings with no labels yet.
_missing_severity: Score used for a Parents Guide category IMDb has no data for (0=None .. 3=Severe). Such films are shown as estimates.

rating_floor._comment: Uncalibrated: no labelled R or NC-17 films yet.
